title: Capstone: Complete Collaborative Workflow Simulation
introduction: Congratulations on reaching Day 15! Today is your **Capstone**: bringing every single skill from the past two weeks together into one unified, end-to-end simulated production workflow. You will experience the exact sequence of actions that professional software engineers follow every single day.
why_it_matters: Knowing individual commands in isolation is good, but stringing them together smoothly into a confident, complete workflow is what makes you an industry-ready engineer who can hit the ground running in any team or hackathon.
practical_activity_preview: Execute the complete 8-step lifecycle: Issue → Branch → Edit & Commit → Push → PR → Review → Merge → Local Sync.
